notes.latexmk_latexrun_vs_auxflow: latexmk and latexrun -- both real, widely-used tools -- independently fail to converge (non-zero exit / rerun-cap reached) on b11_width, b12_float and b13_varioref, the exact three documents AuxFlow's static analysis wrongly CERTIFIES (declared false negatives). This is concrete, measured, cross-tool confirmation that the mechanism is real non-convergence, not a corpus-authoring artifact.
notes.tectonic_offline_coverage: Only b01_plain and b08_cycle converge offline against the build-time-primed bundle; the remaining documents need network access to Tectonic's own file index for packages/fonts outside the primer set (--network=none is enforced for every container, per docs/EVALUATION.md reproducibility). b09_thesis additionally fails because Tectonic's sandboxed bundle does not see the repo-local auditthesis.cls. Disclosed limitation, not fabricated success.

b11_width.note: No Typst analogue for LaTeX's stale-first-pass line-break width feedback; see bench/harness/typst-ports/README.md.

b12_float.note: LaTeX-specific [!t] float placement heuristic has no Typst counterpart.

b13_varioref.note: varioref's above/below text selection is a LaTeX-package-specific mechanism.

b14_ifthen.note: Typst's internal relayout finds a genuine fixpoint LaTeX's single-pass .aux write/reread model cannot see; evidence for AuxFlow's documented over-approximation on this member.
